projects.title: legion-linux-toolkit
projects.description: A full control deck for Lenovo Legion laptops on Linux — power profiles, battery, RGB, fans, overclocking. PyQt6 GUI + tray + CLI with a native HID driver underneath.

projects.title: control-you-device-with-your-hands
projects.description: Full mouse control from a webcam — cursor, clicks, scroll and drag via hand gestures. MediaPipe + OpenCV with jitter-free tracking.

projects.title: chess
projects.description: Browser chess vs the computer — three difficulties, three board themes, legal-move engine. Minimax under the hood, chess.com leaderboards on the side.

projects.title: forest-journal
projects.description: A quiet little journaling app — write the day down, keep it somewhere green. Ambient sound, particles and a guided tour, thoughts, but make it forest.

projects.title: burgers
projects.description: A burger joint website — loud, greasy, and proud of it. Multi-page HTML and CSS with a little spread of javascript on top.

projects.title: ideas
projects.description: A place for half-formed thoughts — every idea gets a page before it evaporates by morning.
